name: Jira
description: Project management: Atlassian's issue tracking and agile project management platform for software and business teams.
access_notes: Jira Cloud has a free plan; any Atlassian account can generate API tokens self-serve (id.atlassian.com) for basic auth, and OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps are created self-serve in the Atlassian developer console. Connect/Forge apps use JWT and are also self-serve to develop (Marketplace listing has a review process).
mcp_notes: Atlassian hosts the official Rovo MCP Server at https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp (OAuth 2.1 or API token) covering Jira, Confluence, JSM, Bitbucket, Compass; official GitHub repo atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server. Composio has a managed JIRA toolkit (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/jira).
uncertainty_notes: Rovo MCP server is Atlassian Cloud only (no Server/Data Center).

evidence.note: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) authorization_code flow for external apps; apps created and managed self-serve in the developer console; API calls via api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/{cloudid}.
Basic auth with Atlassian account email + API token (passwords deprecated); tokens generated self-serve from the Atlassian account.
Webhooks registerable via admin UI or REST API for Connect/OAuth 2.0 apps and other integrations.
Official cloud-hosted Atlassian Rovo MCP Server at mcp.atlassian.com; OAuth 2.1; search/create/edit/transition Jira issues.
Official Atlassian GitHub org repo for the remote MCP server confirming vendor ownership.
